rationale: The bead's own deliverable (UiAutomator2Backend, backendForPlatform, the host wiring, exports, tests, melos entry) is close to textbook-additive: every new symbol lives in new files, the two new export lines in leonard_native.dart are pure additions, and the one behavioral edit to shared code — bin/leonard_native_host.dart swapping a direct `AppiumBackend(...)` construction for `backendForPlatform(...)` — preserves the existing iOS default byte-for-byte (same params, same class) while upgrading an uncaught-throw failure mode to a caught `ArgumentError` -> exit(64). AppiumBackend itself is untouched, so the live-proven iOS path (m5) is not disturbed, and FakeNativeBackend/native_extension/native_perception/native_snapshot are all consumed unchanged. The riskiest edge inside the bead's own code is `UiAutomator2Backend.press` throwing `NativeException` for iOS-only keys (`consent_accept`/`alert_dismiss`) rather than no-op'ing — correct per the design, but it means any future caller that reuses the iOS press vocabulary against an Android backend without adaptive handling gets a hard failure instead of a silent skip; this is deliberate and documented, so it's a minor, contained edge rather than a regression path. The one thing that keeps this off an A: the pinned diff also carries two commits (12cf598, 22d11c4) touching packages/leonard_flutter/lib/src/binding/leonard_binding.dart — a shared, hot-path file used by every LeonardBinding consumer app — which restructure the extension-init microtask around a new `extensionsReady` Completer and widen `get_stable_observation` VM-service registration from `kDebugMode`-only to `kDebugMode || kProfileMode`. Neither change is mentioned in this bead's plan or Touches list, both are unguarded by any opt-in flag beyond the build-mode check itself, and the profile-mode widening changes what capability a released profile build now exposes over the VM service for every consuming app — a plausible, if narrow, regression surface that this bead's diff carries without owning or testing.
